usage: 蓮蓉酥 is used as a noun to refer to a specific type of sweet pastry filled with lotus seed paste.
You can use 蓮蓉酥 in a sentence as a subject, for example: 蓮蓉酥好好味 (Lotus paste pastry is delicious).
When talking about eating or buying, 蓮蓉酥 often follows verbs like 食 (eat) or 買 (buy).
It can also be used with quantifiers such as '一個' (one piece) or '啲' (some) to specify amount.
In casual speech, 蓮蓉酥 remains unchanged whether singular or plural.
